fields.default:
Most interviews end with “Anything else you’d like to add?” and most customers say no. Last month we tried something different with 40 product teams.

We asked one question instead: “What should I have asked you that I didn’t?” In 31 of 40 calls, the answer was the most useful thing anyone said all hour.

Here is why it works, the three ways teams phrased it and the follow-up that turns a shrug into a story.
